items.title: University of the People: Free Online MS & PhD Degrees
items.summary: University of the People offers fully online, tuition‑free MS and PhD degrees that are accessible to students in Pakistan, India, and around the globe. The programs are designed to fit busy schedules, allowing learners to study at their own pace while earning a recognized credential. Admission is open to anyone who meets the basic academic and English proficiency requirements.
items.meta_description: Apply for tuition‑free online MS and PhD programs at University of the People. Open to students in Pakistan, India, and worldwide. Flexible schedule, no tuition fees.
eligibility: High school diploma or equivalent with a minimum GPA requirement.
Proof of English proficiency (TOEFL, IELTS, or equivalent).
Valid government ID and proof of residency.
benefits: Zero tuition fees – only a modest application fee.
Fully online courses that fit any schedule.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application form on the University of the People website.
Upload transcripts, English proficiency scores, and identification documents.
Submit the application and wait for the admission decision via email.

faqs.q: Are there any hidden costs for the program?
faqs.a: No. The only fee is a small application fee. All course materials and instruction are provided free of charge.

faqs.q: Can I study while working?
faqs.a: Yes. The flexible online format allows you to balance coursework with employment or other commitments.

items.title: Clarendon Fund Scholarships for MS & PhD at Oxford
items.summary: The Clarendon Fund Scholarships are prestigious, full-time awards at the University of Oxford supporting postgraduate research and taught degrees. These scholarships cover tuition fees and provide a generous maintenance stipend to support living costs. They are open to students from all countries, including Pakistan and India, who demonstrate exceptional academic potential. Applicants must first secure a place on a relevant Oxford course before being considered for funding.
